title: Aggodalmak, remények és kihívások (Concerns, Hopes & Challenges)
grammar: Predictive Registers, Future Participles (-andó/-endő) & Societal Discourse in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what causes concern or gives cause for hope with aggodalmat kelt and bizakodásra ad okot.
I can say what I fear and what I trust with tart attól, hogy and bízik abban, hogy.
I can say what a challenge and uncertainty are.
I can describe a hopeful view of the future.
